verdict.rationale: Cooley GO offers jurisdiction-specific documents (Delaware incorporation package, UK NDA, UK/Singapore SAFE variants) and a general 'guidance' hub, showing some multi-jurisdiction coverage, but there is no evidence of dedicated comparative guidance on choosing entity type/jurisdiction (Delaware C-corp vs UK Ltd vs German GmbH/UG vs Indian Pvt Ltd) as a founder decision framework. Missing for 10: explicit entity-type/jurisdiction comparison guidance, any mention of German GmbH/UG or Indian Pvt Ltd entities, and independent corroboration of such guidance content.
